cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organize the birthday lunch you really want. Choose the place and I'll get us there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside one. But you'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds gone. Fine. You love the sea; I'll make the drive part of the treat. You choose the route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty to hold the window table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty bloody pounds before lunch. Give me the number; I'm paying for your sea view. Ask them for the best window, and don't you settle for a view of the bins.
